messages.author: fee73ca0c556eec2
messages.subject: error:   in call to ‘sample’
parts:
Hi everyone!

I am trying to install Stan in the computer cluster of my University. Apparently the installation was done without errors (some warnings). Also the sentence 

bin/stanc --name=bernoulli --o=bernoulli.cpp src/models/basic_estimators/bernoulli.stan

works without errors. But then something wrong happens:

g++ -O3 -Lbin -Isrc -Ilib/boost_1.54.0 -Ilib/eigen_3.2.0 src/models/basic_estimators/bernoulli.cpp -o bernoulli -lstan

In file included from src/stan/model/model_header.hpp:20,
                 from src/models/basic_estimators/bernoulli.cpp:3:
src/stan/mcmc/sample.hpp: In function ‘int stan::gm::command(int, const char**) [with Model = bernoulli_model_namespace::bernoulli_model]’:
src/models/basic_estimators/bernoulli.cpp:273:   instantiated from here
src/stan/mcmc/sample.hpp:11: error: ‘class stan::mcmc::sample’ is not a function,
src/stan/gm/command.hpp:157: error:   conflict with ‘template<class Model, class RNG> void stan::gm::sample(stan::mcmc::base_mcmc*, int, int, int, int, bool, stan::io::mcmc_writer<Model>&, stan::mcmc::sample&, Model&, RNG&)’
src/stan/gm/command.hpp:887: error:   in call to ‘sample’ 

Any help would be welcome
Best regards
Angel

parts: On Thu, Nov 7, 2013 at 11:07 AM, Jonathan French <jona...@metrumrg.com> wrote:

I get the same error messages when I try to compile the bernoulli model.

I've installed stan under Ubuntu with make version 3.81 and g++ version 4.4.3.  I don't seem to have any issues with the installation and the translation to C++ seems fine.  The error is when I compile.  

Was there a solution to this issue?

Yes, the issue is a user error. Bob explained in his email, but I'll give it another try. If you want to be less error prone, try using the makefiles provided. For help, just type 'make' on the command line and it'll show you an example of how to compile the normal model.


I'll assume that bin/stanc has been built. This line translates from a Stan model 'src/models/basic_estimators/bernoulli.stan' and generates a C++ file in './bernoulli.cpp':
> bin/stanc --name=bernoulli --o=bernoulli.cpp src/models/basic_estimators/bernoulli.stan

This line is incorrect because it is trying to compile the C++ file in './src/models/basic_estimators/bernoulli.cpp'
> g++ -O3 -Lbin -Isrc -Ilib/boost_1.54.0 -Ilib/eigen_3.2.0 src/models/basic_estimators/bernoulli.cpp -o bernoulli -lstan

To fix it, it should be:
> g++ -O3 -Lbin -Isrc -Ilib/boost_1.54.0 -Ilib/eigen_3.2.0 bernoulli.cpp -o bernoulli -lstan



Hopefully that fixes your problem.

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: error: in call to ‘sample’

Ok. There's definitely a problem. The g++ line is missing the options specifying the stan library. The g++ line above should be:
g++ -I src -isystem lib/eigen_3.2.0 -isystem lib/boost_1.54.0 -Wall -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS -c -O3 -o src/models/basic_distributions/normal.o src/models/basic_distributions/normal.cpp -Lbin -lstan

Would you mind trying that from the command line and seeing if that succeeds?

Just to double check, you're still on:
Ubuntu with make version 3.81 and g++ version 4.4.3

Can you type "make" on the command line and paste the top portion? The LDLIBS variable should be set to "-Lbin -lstan", but it looks like that has been erased somehow.


Daniel
